verdict.rationale: Brevo documents unlimited automated, multi-step workflows that engage users at key moments, plus signup-triggered follow-ups, score-based triggers and send-time optimization, all of which run in the background once configured. The evidence is pricing-page and marketing-level only. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on workflow triggers, conditions and execution, evidence that automations can be set up via the API, MCP or AI tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the automations run reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Create an unlimited number of automated, multi-step workflows to engage users at key moments along their journey.
Automatically trigger follow-up emails as soon as someone signs up.
Get contact scores based on engagement, purchases, and behaviors to trigger automations or create targeted segments.
Automatically send emails when each contact is most likely to engage.
